Topic: Change of Basis in Linear Algebra

Target audience: Undergraduate students (Engineering/Mathematics)

Section: section_1 — The Concept of 'Perspective' (Prerequisite Review)

Lecture lines:
Space is the same; coordinate descriptions differ.
Imagine a point viewed through different rulers.
Standard grid lines define our default perspective.
Switching basis changes the coordinate numbers.
The vector stays put; labels just shift.

Planned animations:
1. Display text '#FFFFFF': Perspective aligns objects relative to view.
2. Create a square object in white #FFFFFF, then shift it slightly to indicate 3D depth.
3. Draw thin lines #7F7F7F from the square corners converging at a central point, showing a vanishing point.

Section: section_2 — The Transition Matrix (The Bridge)

Lecture lines:
We need a translator between bases.
The change of basis matrix bridges systems.
Matrix multiplication maps coordinates across perspectives.

Planned animations:
1. Display text '#FFFFFF': The matrix acts as a mapping bridge.
2. Create a 2x2 grid 'A' in #3498DB representing the input space.
3. Create a 2x2 grid 'B' in #E74C3C representing the target space, connecting via arrows.

Section: section_3 — Deriving the Calculation Process

Lecture lines:
Equation: the vector in A equals P times B.
Matrix P columns are basis vectors in A.
Basis vectors serve as the transformation's building blocks.

Planned animations:
1. Display text '#FFFFFF': Apply matrix multiplication sequentially.
2. Show formula M * v = v' with components highlighted in light yellow #F1C40F.
3. Animate row-by-column dot products by highlighting elements moving into position in #2ECC71.

Section: section_4 — Practical Application & Summary

Lecture lines:
Choosing a smart basis simplifies complex motion.
Rotation is just scaling in the right basis.
Change of basis reveals the simplest perspective.

Planned animations:
1. Display text '#FFFFFF': Choosing a smart basis simplifies complex motion.
2. Replace abstract matrix with image in the center.
3. Flash the transform matrix in #2ECC71 around the asset to finalize the visual link.
